title: Soldiers of Christ, Arise
description: Soldiers of Christ, Arise in Tonic Solfa to DIADEMATA: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the three verses, and a piano.
about: Charles Wesley’s words on Ephesians 6 were published in Hymns and Sacred Poems in 1749, sixteen verses long; hymn books sing a few of them. Many Nigerian books set them to FROM STRENGTH TO STRENGTH or ST. ETHELWALD; here they are sung to George J. Elvey’s DIADEMATA (1868), which fits the same metre.
underlay: Sol-diers of Christ, a-rise, And put your ar-mour on, Strong in the strength which God sup_-plies Through His e-ter-nal Son. Strong in the Lord of hosts, And in His might-y pow’r, Who in the strength of Je-sus trusts Is more than con-quer-or.

lines: Strong in the strength which God supplies
Strong in the Lord of hosts,
Who in the strength of Jesus trusts
Stand then in His great might,
And take, to arm you for the fight,
Ye may o’ercome through Christ alone,
From strength to strength go on,
Tread all the pow’rs of darkness down
